cloud with eyes cut out of it, on a red-orange or blue sky – it floats, turns to look around, blinks, follows the pointer and bounces with a wink when clicked. $ pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/frost-cloud.json Preview Code Copy prompt MCP Copy When to use A friendly face for an assistant, an AI feature or a cloud product – as an app icon, an empty state or a feature card Landing pages that want a calm, living mascot instead of a static logo When not to use Tiny sizes below ~48px – the glow and the eyes get lost Brands far from blue or orange – the colors are part of the look Installation Add Frost Cloud with the shadcn CLI – your project needs a components.json, see Installation in the docs – or copy the file by hand. Requires React 19.
